note: Bài nghe bổ sung cho Tiếng Anh 6 - Unit 2 (Global Success).

questions.audio_text: A: Hi, Hoa! Is that your house over there? B: Yes, it is. It is the yellow house with a red roof. A: It looks very nice! How many rooms are there? B: There are five rooms: a living room, a kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom.
questions.explain: Câu 1: nhà màu vàng mái đỏ ('yellow house with a red roof'). Câu 2: có 5 phòng (1 phòng khách, 1 bếp, 2 phòng ngủ, 1 phòng tắm).
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

options: A. It is yellow with a red roof
B. It is white with a blue roof
C. It is red with a yellow roof
D. It is blue with a white roof
sub_questions.q: What does Hoa's house look like?
How many rooms are there in Hoa's house?

questions.audio_text: A: Where is the cat, Mom? B: It is under the table in the living room. A: And where is my schoolbag? B: It is on the chair next to the sofa. A: Thanks, Mom! B: And your books are in the bookcase behind the door.
questions.explain: Câu 1: con mèo ở dưới gầm bàn phòng khách ('under the table'). Câu 2: sách ở trong tủ sách sau cánh cửa ('in the bookcase behind the door').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

options: D. In the bookcase behind the door

questions.audio_text: A: What does your living room look like, Ba? B: It is large and bright. There is a big sofa in the middle, a TV on the wall and a bookshelf in the corner. A: Is there a clock? B: Yes, there is a round clock above the TV. My dad bought it last year.
questions.explain: Câu 1: có đồng hồ ('Yes, there is a round clock above the TV'). Câu 2: đồng hồ ở phía trên TV ('above the TV').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

sub_questions.q: Is there a clock in Ba's living room?

questions.audio_text: A: This is my bedroom. What do you think? B: Wow! It is so tidy! Is that your desk? A: Yes. I do my homework there every evening. The lamp is on the desk, next to my computer. B: And whose posters are those on the wall? A: They are mine. I love football posters.
questions.explain: Câu 1: đèn ở trên bàn, cạnh máy tính ('on the desk, next to my computer'). Câu 2: áp phích bóng đá ('football posters').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

options: B. On the desk, next to the computer

sub_questions.q: What posters are on the wall?

questions.audio_text: A: Grandma, tell me about your old house in the village. B: Well, it was a small house with a big garden. We grew vegetables and raised chickens there. A: Did it have a bathroom inside? B: No, dear. The bathroom was outside, behind the house. Life was simple but happy.
questions.explain: Câu 1: nhà có vườn rau và nuôi gà ('grew vegetables and raised chickens'). Câu 2: phòng tắm ở ngoài, sau nhà ('outside, behind the house').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

options: A. It was big and modern
B. It was small with a big garden
C. It was small with no garden
D. It was near the city
sub_questions.q: What was Grandma's old house like?

options: C. In front of the house

questions.audio_text: A: I am looking for a new apartment, Mai. B: What kind of apartment do you want? A: I want one near my school, with two bedrooms. My budget is about five million dong a month. B: I know a nice one on Nguyen Trai Street. It has two bedrooms, a small balcony, and it costs four and a half million a month. A: That sounds perfect! Can we visit it tomorrow?
questions.explain: Câu 1: cần căn hộ 2 phòng ngủ ('with two bedrooms'). Câu 2: giá 4,5 triệu/tháng ('four and a half million a month').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

sub_questions.q: How many bedrooms does the speaker want?
How much does the apartment on Nguyen Trai Street cost?

subject: ANH
